items.claim: Uros Medic is not a first-round-or-bust fighter, evidenced by his third-round knockout of Matthew Semelsberger.
items.quote: Uro Medic is first round or bust. That's complete [__] He's killer be killed, but he is not first round or bust. If he was first round or bust, then why did he knock out Matthew Semlesberger in the third round?
